parameters.name: options.format
parameters.description: Optional output format for the captured image. Default: type: image/png, quality: 0.8

parameters.name: options.onCapture
parameters.description: Optional callback triggered after a successful capture. Provides both the Base64 string and the raw File Blob.

parameters.name: options.width
parameters.description: The desired output width of the image. Height is scaled automatically. Default: 320.

returnValues.name: canvasRef
returnValues.description: Ref to the hidden <canvas /> used for processing the image data.

returnValues.name: capture
returnValues.description: Captures the current frame, renders it to the imageRef, and returns the Data URL.

returnValues.name: imageRef
returnValues.description: Ref to attach to an tag to display the last captured photo.

returnValues.name: requestPermission
returnValues.description: Async function that prompts the user for camera access and starts the stream.

returnValues.name: stop
returnValues.description: Releases the camera hardware and stops all active media tracks.

returnValues.name: usePermission
returnValues.description: Returns whether the user has successfully granted camera access.

returnValues.name: useStreaming
returnValues.description: Returns the current active state of the video stream.

returnValues.name: videoRef
returnValues.description: Ref to attach to the <video /> tag for the live stream.
